remarks: Welcome to this exceptional new build offering 1,855 sq. ft. of thoughtfully designed living space. The main floor features a convenient bedroom and full bathroom-perfect for guests or multi-generational living. An open-to-below design enhances the bright, airy open-concept layout, while the spice kitchen provides added functionality for cooking enthusiasts. Upstairs, you'll find three spacious bedrooms, including a primary suite, along with a versatile bonus room ideal for a home office or family space. The unfinished basement includes a separate side entrance, offering excellent potential for future legal suite development. Property is under construction. Ideally located close to schools, shopping, and parks, this home blends modern style with everyday practicality in the desirable Stillwater community. (id:67522)
